description: Read and parse a website's robots.txt: user-agent groups with allow/disallow rules, declared sitemaps, and which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot...) are blocked from the whole site. Fast (under 2 s). Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.

name: robots
